payload.body: A SKILL.md wrapper for nahel was evaluated cross-vendor (claude + codex + cursor-agent, 2026-08-19): worth-it-with-conditions. It must be a thin GENERATED router emitted by nahel install — never a third onboarding document — sharing every line with the AGENTS.md orientation template and the workflow frontmatter so nothing new can drift; always-on rules (NAHEL_ACTOR, never hand-edit) stay enforced by the AGENTS.md section. Timing dissent: codex said build now as a compatibility adapter, cursor-agent said wait until a skill-capable-but-AGENTS.md-blind host is actually in the target set; Jim sided with cursor-agent and moved node skill-entry-shim t4nsm0de to horizon later. Precondition: coin a CONTEXT.md term (working name 'skill entry shim') distinguishing this PRODUCED artifact from ADR-0009's CONSUMED skill dependencies.
